name: Glide-extension
description: Warm-paper browser automation extension with configurable LLM providers

scripts.validate: npm run build:ext && npm run build:test && node dist/tests/validate-extension.js
scripts.test: npm run build:ext && npm run build:test && node dist/tests/run-tests.js
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:ext && npm run build:test && node dist/tests/unit/run-unit-tests.js
scripts.test:integration: echo 'Load tests/integration/test-page.html in browser and run tests'
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:ext && npm run build:test && node dist/tests/e2e/run-e2e.js
scripts.dev: echo 'Run npm run build, then load the dist/ folder in Chrome://extensions'
